name: What factors determine the cost of shower removal?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of shower removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to remove a bathroom shower varies widely based on materials, accessibility, and the shower type. Light demolition of an acrylic or fiberglass stall requires fewer labor hours than breaking apart thick tile, wire lath, and solid mud beds. Disposal logistics also affect the estimate, including dumpster placement, hauling fees, and whether plumbing rough-ins must be capped or altered. If subfloor rot or moisture intrusion is uncovered during tear-out, repairing the framing adds to the overall scope. An on-site inspection provides the most accurate pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the shower material, whether it is tile or fiberglass, disposal logistics, plumbing work, and any needed repairs for water damage beneath the pan.
